create_MonolingualDataset: create a MonolingualDataset wrapper for monolingual data with source and target vocabularies
collate_samples: collate a list of monolingual samples into a mini-batch with padded source tokens and targets
make_source_target: build source and target tensors from future and past targets for language modeling
ordered_indices: generate an ordered list of indices for batching with optional shuffling and size sorting
prefetch_dataset: prefetch specified indices from the underlying dataset for faster data loading
